title: Sources & further reading
body:
This guide leans on official operators and government/city tourism sites wherever they could be reached: Fukuoka Airport, Nishitetsu, JR Kyushu, the Nimoca IC card, Dazaifu Tenmangu, the Kyushu National Museum, Itoshima City Tourism, Fukuoka City's official tourist guide, and Japan National Tourism Organization.

Two official sources block automated access outright: Japan's Ministry of Foreign Affairs (mofa.go.jp) and the US State Department (travel.state.gov) — both cite well-established, low-risk facts (the 90-day visa waiver; the general advisory level) that are cross-checked against JNTO and press coverage instead, but are worth re-checking directly before travel.
